Identify:
Provides magical information about the item that your target is holding.


To use the spell on yourself, pick the item you want to identify from your inventory by left clicking it, so that it's held on your cursor (as if you were moving the item). Then, with the item held on your cursor, target yourself and cast the spell.

To use the spell on others, have them hold their item to be identified on their cursor while you cast the spell on them.

Gravity Flux:
Two different incompatible versions of this spell exists in game. One is crafted by Wizards and the other is crafted by Enchanters. Causes a sudden reversal in the gravity around your target, doing 214 damage. Only hits 4 mobs max. Please confirm damage at various levels.

Quad-kiting Wizards are recommended to use the more mana efficient Circle of Force until level 51, then Pillar of Frost. This spell has an alternate use to project yourself/duel to locations not easily accessible like ramparts of CoM. When cast by NPCs, this spell can be very dangerous against players, as fall damage can be very brutal, especially if they are overweight or fall off nearby cliffs. Levitate and Dead Man Floating can counter this risk.

Hurls your target back through the air in a shallow, horizontal arc.

When cast on the player by NPCs such as tentacle terrors, the player flies (often quite a considerable distance) in the opposite direction from where they are facing. The position of the NPC and player do not matter. Levitate and related effects will mitigate knockback's movement.

When a player applies this effect to an NPC, the distance the NPC is knocked back is much less. The direction of the knockback is on the same vector as where the casting player is facing, regardless of the NPC's position or facing direction. Hate generated from this effect is between 25 and 100.

When a player applies the effect to themselves, they are always knocked back due south.

TravelerBoots: Fills your feet with speed, increasing your movement rate for up to 3.0 mins @L1 to 18.0 mins @L6.
Weak Poison: Poisons your target, causing 6 damage initially and 6 damage every 6 seconds for up to 1 min.
Wrath of Nature: Grips your target in the wrath of nature, slowing their movement speed and causing 55 damage every 6 seconds for 180 secs (1650 damage total). Overwrites and blocks Snare and Ensnare.
Torment of Shadows: Consumes your target in shadows, slowing movement rate and causing 75 damage every 6 seconds for 1.6 mins for 1200 damage.
Ykesha: This DD proc will interrupt spells and cause 475 hate.
Velium Shards: Strikes your target with velium shards, causing 12 damage.
Telescope: Strengthens your vision, allowing you to see much farther.
Truesight: Fills your eyes with magical energy, granting greatly enhanced night vision and the ability to see otherwise invisible creatures.
Torment: Enflames your target's wounds, causing 20 damage initially, and 10 damage every 6 seconds for up to 6 secs (1 ticks @L1 to 5 ticks @L10).
Vampiric Curse: Drains the life from your target, doing 21 damage every six seconds for 54s. 7% of the life-force taken is used to heal your wounds.
Voice Graft: Allows you to speak through your undead servant.
Thorny Shield: Causes thorns to grow from your body, damaging any creature that attacks you.
Waves of the Deep Sea: Crushes your target with a wave of water, causing 20 damage every 6 seconds and lowering attack speed for up to 6 secs (1 ticks @L1 to 2.5 mins @L50).
Yaulp IV: Focuses your spiritual energy into a great battle cry, increasing your strength, armor class, and attack rating for 24 secs (4 ticks). It does not stack with Speed of the Shissar. Increased ATK by 27 (L53) to 31 (L60) until Feb. 2001, when Paladins gained the spell.
Weaken: Weakens your opponent, lowering their strength.
Word of Shadow: A forbidden word that causes between 52 and 58 damage to all nearby enemies.
Tepid Deeds: Constricts your target's muscles, reducing attack speed by 50% for 3 min 30s.
Vigor of Zehkes: Restores your warder's health, healing 671 hit points, as well as curing them of diseases, poisons, and curses.
Wind Resonance 10: Increases the power of wind instrument based bard songs by up to 100%.
Tavee's Lesser Diuturnity: Increases the duration of beneficial spells by 15%. This bonus will decay on spells over level 16.
Tavee's Charm of Diuturnity: Increases the duration of beneficial spells by 15%. This bonus will decay on spells over level 49.
Tavee's Superior Diuturnity: Increases the duration of beneficial spells by 15%. This bonus will decay on spells over level 65.
Tavee's Greater Diuturnity: Increases the duration of beneficial spells by 15%. This bonus will decay on spells over level 60.
